in_marathi.name: Guhaarika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Guhaarika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Guhaarika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Guha' which means cave. The suffix 'arika' means dweller, indicating someone who lives in a cave. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted living in a cave, making this name symbolic of his divine presence and protection.
